name: Built in UST
tagline: Minnesota-grown wild rice, sweet corn, and sunflower seeds, sourced directly from family farms.
about: Built in UST is a student-run sourcing firm in the OPMT 375 Supply Lab. We buy directly from Minnesota growers, from wild rice paddies in the north to sweet corn fields in the south, and sell raw ingredients to manufacturers who need a steady, traceable supply. Every lot comes with the farm of origin and the harvest date, so you always know where your ingredients came from.
how_to_order: Open a new issue in this repo. Let us know which product you need, how many pounds or bushels, and the date you want it at your door. We will answer in the issue within 5 business days with a price and a confirmed delivery date.
